scripts.build: bunx --bun --no-install tsc --noEmit && bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build favicons --out packages/app-capacitor/public && bunx --bun --no-install vite build
scripts.cap:prepare: bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build native && bun scripts/prepareMobile.ts
scripts.cap:sync:debug: bun run cap:prepare && bunx --bun --no-install cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:release: bun run cap:prepare && NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bunx --bun --no-install cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:staging: bun run cap:prepare && NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=staging bunx --bun --no-install cap sync
scripts.android:build:debug: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android build_debug
scripts.android:build:release: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android build_release
scripts.android:build:google-play: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android build_google_play_release
scripts.android:build:google-play:staging: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=staging bundle exec fastlane android build_google_play_release
scripts.android:upload:google-play: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android upload_google_play_release
scripts.android:upload:google-play:staging: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=staging bundle exec fastlane android upload_google_play_release
scripts.android:sideload: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android sideload
scripts.android:sideload:debug: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android install_debug
scripts.android:sideload:release: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android install_release
scripts.ios:build:testflight: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios build_testflight_release
scripts.ios:build:testflight:staging: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=staging bundle exec fastlane ios build_testflight_release
scripts.ios:upload:testflight: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios upload_testflight_release
scripts.ios:upload:testflight:staging: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=staging bundle exec fastlane ios upload_testflight_release
scripts.ios:fetch:appstore-profile: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios fetch_appstore_profile
scripts.ios:fetch:appstore-profile:staging: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=staging bundle exec fastlane ios fetch_appstore_profile
